about.heroDesc: BIAK — Bethany International Apostolic Kingdom — is an international Christian church in Brønderslev, Denmark, founded by Pastors Martin and Ruth Mutale.
about.story1: BIAK was founded with a vision to create a home for everyone — regardless of nationality, background or past. The church brings together people from over 10 nations under one roof in Brønderslev.
about.story2: We believe that the church is more than a building — it is a community of believers who desire to experience God and follow Jesus in everyday life.
about.story3: Our services are held in Danish, English, Swahili and Spanish — because we want everyone to meet God in their own mother tongue.

b1.title: Biblical Authority
b1.desc: We believe the Bible is God's inspired and infallible word — our guide for faith and life.

b2.title: Salvation by Grace
b2.desc: Salvation is God's gift to all who believe — not something we earn, but something we receive.

b3.title: Power of the Holy Spirit
b3.desc: We believe in the Holy Spirit's active work today — with signs, wonders and spiritual gifts.

b4.title: The Body of Christ
b4.desc: The church is not a building but a community — the Body of Christ on earth.

b5.title: Return of Jesus
b5.desc: We live in expectation of Jesus' visible, physical return to establish His kingdom.

b6.title: Mission & Gospel
b6.desc: We are called to share the gospel locally and globally — to all nations.

sermons.heroDesc: Sermons, teaching and talks from our services and meetings.

youth.heroDesc: BIAK Youth is a place for young people to meet, build community, worship and grow in faith.
youth.info1: We meet once a month for our youth meeting — with worship, teaching, fun and strong community. You don't need to have experience with Christianity. You are welcome just as you are.
youth.info2: The youth group is led by dedicated young leaders under the guidance of Pastor Ruth Mutale, who has a passion for seeing young people grow in their faith and identity.
youth.featuresHint: Click a box to read more

f1.title: Worship
f1.detail: Our worship time is the heart of every meeting. We sing with all our hearts and invite God's presence into the room — whether you've sung before or not.

f2.title: Community
f2.detail: Here you meet young people from many different backgrounds and nations. We eat, laugh and build friendships that go far beyond the meeting evening.

f3.title: Teaching
f3.detail: Every gathering includes relevant and practical teaching from the Bible — delivered in a way that makes sense for young people today.

f4.title: Activities
f4.detail: Beyond the monthly meetings, we arrange trips, sports evenings, summer camps and spontaneous activities — because there's more to life than four walls.
